AppFunctionAppMetadata.appfn:description: Spesify tracks personal expenses and incomes. Exposed functions can add a single non-recurring transaction, read total expenses or income for the current month, read total expenses or income for a user-specified month, read total expenses or income for an inclusive user-specified period, and read the current balance. Amounts are returned in both integer minor currency units and localized display format. Current balance matches the dashboard cumulative balance through the current calendar month. For adding transactions, amounts should be provided in normal user-facing currency format, for example $55.56, 55.56, or 55,56; Spesify converts them internally to integer minor currency units. Expenses require a category name or category ID; incomes can be saved without a category. If category, amount, kind, date, month, or period are ambiguous, ask the user for confirmation instead of inventing missing data.
